🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷 Rotary Friendship Exchange – A Celebration of Global Friendship

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
RFE with District 4895 | Buenos Aires, Argentina

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27, 10 Rotarians from Rotary, District 3141, India, had the privilege of connecting with fellow Rotarians of District 4895, Buenos Aires, Argentina.

Rotary meeting at the iconic Café Tortoni, one of Argentina’s oldest and most historic cafés. The ceremony was hosted in the warm company of Rotary Club Catedral al Sur – Premier Club de Desayuno en Argentina.

The exchange of fellowship beautifully represented the spirit of Rotary—friendship, fellowship, cultural understanding and international goodwill. Two countries and two cultures came together to create a bond that goes far beyond geographical boundaries.

The warm welcome extended by our Argentine Rotary friends made the occasion truly special. The gathering was filled with camaraderie, meaningful conversations and the shared joy of being part of the worldwide Rotary family.

From Mumbai to Buenos Aires – Friendships Strengthened, Hearts Connected. 🇮🇳❤️🇦🇷

A memorable chapter in the Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27, strengthening the beautiful bond between District 3141 and District 4895.
